_doc: The villagers' lines (the list of 2026-11-20's eighth phase, items 27 and 28): what a village's household says, by role; {village} is the village's name. Read by 934 folk into the brokenspire generator's WildVillageLines15 as role|line.
villager: We cut these ledges into the hill ourselves, my father and his brothers. Every stone in that wall came out of the ground it holds up.
The well in the square has never run dry, not in the worst summer. That's why {village} is where it is.
Mind the drop past the wall when you leave by the back. More than one carter's gone over it in the dark.
We trade wool and cheese down the road for salt and iron. Prices are fair if you don't mind the walk.
There's been beasts on the ridge at night. We keep the doors barred after dusk now.
If you're bound for the towns, take the road down past the last house. The old path along the slope washed out in spring.
villagewoman: Feeding the hens is the easy part. Keeping the foxes from them is the work.
My mother was born in that house, and her mother before. The walls have been patched more than they've been built.
You look like you've come a long way. There's water at the well, and nobody in {village} will begrudge you a cup.
Market day is when the carts come up from the valley. The rest of the week it's just us and the goats.
The children know every step of every terrace. Don't follow them if you value your ankles.
We had a stranger through here last month asking about the ruins. Never saw him come back.
child: I can climb the big wall by the stairs! Well, almost to the top.
Do you have a sword? Can I hold it?
My brother says there's a dragon past the hills. He's lying, isn't he?
I found a shiny stone by the well. You can't have it.
We're not allowed past the last house after dark.
any: Welcome to {village}. It's not much, but it's ours.
Fine weather for the season, if it holds.
Keep to the paths and the ledges, and you'll not go wrong here.
